mapper.select: select a.id,a.perms from sys_menu a left join sys_role_menu b on a.id = b.menu_id where FIND_IN_SET(b.role_id,#{id}) GROUP BY a.id order by parent_id,sort
mapper.sql: select a.id,a.name as title,parent_id,name,type,url,path,state,ifnull(perms,'') as perms,icon, sort,visible,active_menu from sys_menu a left join sys_role_menu b on a.id = b.menu_id
mapper.select: where FIND_IN_SET( b.role_id,#{id}) and type in ('M', 'C') and a.state = 1 GROUP BY a.id order by parent_id,sort
